name: Suzhou Gold Mantis Construction Decoration Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Gold Mantis Construction Decoration Co., Ltd., engages in the provision of interior decoration, architecture, curtain wall, landscape, building intelligence, and soft decoration solutions in China. It also undertakes public building decoration and residential decoration projects which covers hotel decoration, cultural and sports exhibition building decoration, commercial building decoration, transportation infrastructure decoration, and residential decoration. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
